name: HEC Research Travel Grant (conference paper presentation)
amount: International: economy airfare as per Government rules + registration fee up to USD 500 (reimbursed after the event)
duration: One-off (max one grant per person per financial year)
eligibility: Principal (first/corresponding) author who is regular faculty (not visiting) or MS/MPhil/PhD scholar at a public-sector HEI or eligible private university; conference must have peer-reviewed, archived proceedings
eligibility_note: Domestic HEC scheme for faculty and scholars of Pakistani universities; a postdoc must hold a regular faculty post to qualify
how_to_apply_tip: Upload on the HEC research portal at least 60 days before the conference, with paper acceptance and NOCs from all co-authors; claim reimbursement within 1 month of return.

name: National Research Program for Universities (NRPU)
amount: See website (project budgets set per call)
eligibility: PI must be a regular faculty member/eligible academic at a recognized Pakistani HEI; basic and applied research in all fields incl. CS; junior staff encouraged on teams
eligibility_note: National HEC programme for faculty of Pakistani HEIs; 2026-27 call removed the application fee and the delayed-cases bar; joint proposals with foreign (esp. KSA) researchers encouraged
deadline: Annual – usually October (2026-27 outline deadline was 2026-10-30, now closed)
how_to_apply_tip: Next call likely autumn 2027: draft a project outline now, line up a co-PI/industry partner, and route it through your university ORIC on research.hec.gov.pk.

name: Start-up Research Grant Program (SRGP) for fresh PhDs
amount: See website (covers equipment, supplies, laptop/printer; quotations needed for items > PKR 100,000)
eligibility: Fresh PhD (within 2 years of application) newly joining a public or publicly-fundable private HEI as faculty; HEC page states it targets IPFP fellows; one-time only, no re-application
eligibility_note: Pakistani faculty only; current HEC/NAHE page frames SRGP for IPFP (Interim Placement of Fresh PhDs) fellows – confirm whether non-IPFP regular faculty can still apply
how_to_apply_tip: You get only one chance and incomplete files are rejected: collect 3 vendor quotations, signed ORIC/VC undertaking and budget sheet before submitting the online form.

name: HEC Post-Doctoral Fellowship Program (Phase III)
amount: Living allowance (reported ~USD 1,600/month, varies by host country) + one-time health insurance, airfare and research/bench costs – see Financial Support page
eligibility: Age <= 45; local HEC-attested PhD, or foreign PhD + 5 years work in Pakistan; regular employee of HEC-recognized HEI or PCST-recognized R&D org; no previous postdoc (>3 months); placement at QS top-200 university
eligibility_note: Only for Pakistani regular employees of Pakistani HEIs/R&D orgs; foreign-PhD holders need 5 years post-PhD service in Pakistan (local-PhD holders do not)
deadline: Annual – last batch closed 2025-10-30 (check for next batch)
how_to_apply_tip: Secure a placement letter from a QS top-200 supervisor (dated within 6 months) and a 9-month leave NOC before the portal (pdfp.hec.gov.pk) opens.

name: PERIDOT – Pakistan-France Hubert Curien Partnership (researcher mobility)
funder: HEC Pakistan & Campus France / French Ministries
amount: Mobility costs (travel/stay) for joint team visits – see website for per-visit amounts
eligibility: PI must be regular faculty (PhD) at a Pakistani public/private HEI (or contract covering project duration) with a French partner who applies in parallel; PhD students integrated
eligibility_note: Bilateral HEC-France programme exclusively for Pakistani university researchers paired with French teams
how_to_apply_tip: Find a French collaborator early – both sides must submit (Campus France + HEC) or the proposal is rejected; recent priority themes are health, energy, agriculture, climate economics, so frame AI as an enabler.

name: CAS-ANSO Visiting Scientist Fellowship
funder: Alliance of International Science Organizations (ANSO) / Chinese Academy of Sciences
amount: RMB 15,000/month (assistant prof/postdoc level), RMB 25,000 (associate), RMB 35,000 (full prof) + one round-trip travel subsidy
eligibility: Scholars outside mainland China at assistant professor level (incl. postdocs) or above; must be formal employees of home institution; applied via a CAS host researcher
eligibility_note: Open to researchers from outside mainland China; ANSO members get priority (several Pakistani institutions are ANSO partners – check member list)
deadline: Annual – usually April (2025 call closed 24 April)
how_to_apply_tip: Contact a CAS institute host (e.g. Institute of Automation or Institute of Computing Technology) by early spring – the host submits on your behalf.

name: Talented Young Scientist Program (TYSP)
funder: Ministry of Science and Technology of China / China Science and Technology Exchange Center
eligibility: Under 45, doctoral degree and >5 years research experience; hosted by a Chinese university, institute or company
eligibility_note: Programme targets young scientists from developing (Afro-Asian / Belt and Road) countries; Pakistani researchers have been selected (e.g. IUB lecturer, 2026), but exclusion list on official page is garbled – confirm
how_to_apply_tip: The Chinese host institution registers on the TYSP platform and submits your information – find a host by December for the Jan-Mar call.

name: COMSTECH Research Fellowship Programme (CCoE)
funder: OIC Ministerial Standing Committee on Scientific and Technological Cooperation (COMSTECH)
amount: Low-cost international return airfare paid by COMSTECH; subsistence/supervision by host centre of excellence
eligibility: Young researchers with MS (age <= 35) or PhD (age <= 45) or active researchers; citizens of or employed in an OIC member state; preference to early-career researchers
eligibility_note: Open to citizens of all OIC member states (Pakistan is a member and COMSTECH host); placement at CCoE member institutions in OIC countries
how_to_apply_tip: Pick a CCoE host outside Pakistan from COMSTECH's list, then email the online form, CV, 2 references and head-of-institution letter to comstech@comstech.org.

name: Fulbright Scholar Program (Pakistan) – postdoctoral research / lectureship in the US
amount: Airfare, living stipend, health insurance, research allowance + support for one dependent
eligibility: PhD/terminal degree, all fields except clinical medicine; invitation letter from US university; NOT eligible if PhD earned within last 2 years or in US for research/study in last 5 years
eligibility_note: Pakistani citizens living/working in Pakistan; dual US nationals excluded. Profile note: becomes eligible once PhD is >2 years old
deadline: Annual – usually late October (2027 cycle closed 2026-10-28)
how_to_apply_tip: Start emailing US hosts in summer 2027: an invitation letter must be in the application, along with 3 references.

name: PSF Research Support Programme (Mathematics & Computer Sciences)
eligibility: Individual scientists or research groups at Pakistani universities and R&D organizations; ten fields incl. Mathematics & Computer Sciences; concept paper then full proposal
eligibility_note: Domestic programme (964 projects funded); no current call date published – check RGMS notifications
how_to_apply_tip: Register on rgms.psf.gov.pk and submit a concept paper first; also watch PSF bilateral calls (SCO, NSFC-China, TUBITAK, Sri Lanka NSF) announced on the same portal.

name: PSF Industrial Solution Grants for Young Scientists
funder: Pakistan Science Foundation (PSF) – R&D Industry Programme
eligibility: Young scientists (PI at a Pakistani institution) proposing applied solutions to industrial problems with MS/MPhil/PhD student engagement and an industry partner
eligibility_note: Domestic PSF call for researchers at Pakistani institutions; official notice not directly retrievable – verified via PSF RGMS guide and university ORIC postings
how_to_apply_tip: Secure a letter of commitment from an industry partner and submit via RGMS; AI for manufacturing/quality control fits well.

name: Sindh Research Support Programme (SRSP)
amount: Up to PKR 5 million per project (2026-27 call, per press reports)
eligibility: Full-time regular PhD faculty (BPS/TTS) at universities in Sindh; one proposal as PI; not funded in previous 2 years; IT & Computer Science is a thematic area
eligibility_note: Only for faculty at Sindh universities (provincial scheme)
how_to_apply_tip: Frame the AI project around a Sindh issue (water, health, climate, education) – provincial-priority and collaborative proposals are preferred.

name: Sindh HEC Research Travel Grant Program
eligibility: Faculty of public and private universities (Sindh) presenting at internationally recognized conferences/seminars/symposia
eligibility_note: Provincial scheme for faculty of universities in Sindh
how_to_apply_tip: Download the SHEC travel grant form and policy from the page and apply well before travel; ask info@sindhhec.gov.pk about current ceilings.

name: Sindh HEC International Post-Doctoral Fellowship Programme (Phase II)
amount: Living allowance up to USD 1,500/month (PPP-based) + USD 2,000 health insurance + USD 6,000 research/bench fee + PKR 350,000 return airfare
eligibility: HEC-recognized PhD; regular employee of a Sindh public/private HEI; age <= 50; preferably 5 years post-PhD experience in Sindh; placement at QS top-200 (top-500 considered); Digital Innovation is a priority area
eligibility_note: Requires Sindh domicile and PRC (Form C) plus employment at a Sindh HEI
how_to_apply_tip: Arrange the host placement letter first; post the hard copy and email the PDF to ad.qa@sindhhec.gov.pk with all NOCs.

name: Punjab HEC International Travel Grant
eligibility: Faculty of Punjab public-sector universities/colleges; at least one publication in an HEC-recognized journal in last 5 years; max two awards per university per conference
eligibility_note: Provincial scheme for Punjab faculty; official page is behind a bot-check and could not be fully read – details from PHEC page snippet
how_to_apply_tip: Confirm the application lead time with your university ORIC and apply through it; keep the HEC-journal publication record ready.

name: Punjab HEC International Postdoctoral Scholarship (IPDS)
eligibility: Regular (BPS/TTS) faculty of public-sector universities/colleges chartered by Government of Punjab; no postdoc in last 5 years
eligibility_note: Provincial scheme for Punjab public-sector faculty; official page behind a bot-check, latest dated call found was 2023 – confirm next round
how_to_apply_tip: Get leave/NOC from your parent institution and a host acceptance before the call; hard copies are sent by registered post.
